messages:
emma: Quick heads-up — ran the weekly docs link-scan and found 3 small issues in the runtime guide that block the onboarding flow. Can someone take a 5–10min PR?

docs-bot: Automated link-scan report: 3 findings in /guides/runtime/:
• /guides/runtime/kv-cache.md -> 404 (orphaned anchor)
• /guides/runtime/prefix-caching.md -> image 403 on staging
• /ja/guides/runtime/snippets.md -> deprecated shortlink -> 410

raj: I can pick up the first two this morning. Curious if the ja shortlink needs a rehost or if we should point to the canonical EN page?

emma: Thanks raj. For the ja one, prefer rehosted snippet in the ja directory (so translators can keep context). For kv-cache anchor, it's just a missing heading id; I'll paste the broken anchor in a sec.

emma: Broken anchor: /guides/runtime/kv-cache.md#kv-key-ttl -> file has "## TTL for keys" (no id). Quick fix is to add an explicit id or change the link to the generated slug.

raj: Got it. I'll add explicit id to the heading. Quick sed I plan to run in the branch:
```
sed -n -e 's/^## TTL for keys/## TTL for keys
<!-- anchor: kv-key-ttl -->/' guides/runtime/kv-cache.md
```

jenna: I can review once the PR is up. Can we also include a short note in CHANGELOG/whats-new.md for the ja rehost? PMs ask for a traceable change.

raj: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2145 — includes heading id + image rehost for prefix-caching (uploads image to assets/docs/runtime/). Also added a tiny README in /ja/guides/runtime/ pointing to the rehosted snippet for translators.

docs-bot: CI: docs-build (staging) passed ✅ — preview: https://deploy-preview-2145--docs.redwood.ai/ (staging)

jenna: Reviewing now. Left 1 nit about alt text on the rehosted image.

raj: Fixed alt text and pushed. Also added the CHANGELOG line per @jenna request.

emma: Awesome, thanks both. Once merged can someone trigger the runbook smokecheck? I want to confirm the onboarding quickstart renders correctly.

docs-bot: Smokecheck job queued by @emma — will run after merge.

jenna: LGTM, merging after smokecheck passes. :thumbsup:

emma: Thanks team — appreciate the quick turnaround :tada:
